caveats: NASA's "South Asia" file is bounded by a fixed lat/lon box, which may include parts of adjacent countries beyond the locations listed for this dataset. For arbitrary bounding boxes or country-level extracts, use the FIRMS Area API (https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/area/) with a free MAP_KEY.
dataset_source: NASA Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS)
methodology_other:
Active fire / thermal anomaly detections derived from VIIRS (375 m) instruments aboard the Suomi-NPP, NOAA-20, and NOAA-21 satellites. Detections are produced by NASA's Land, Atmosphere Near real-time Capability for EOS (LANCE) and distributed via FIRMS. See https://earthdata.nasa.gov/faq/firms-faq for algorithm details, known limitations, and disclaimer.

Each detection is a 375 m pixel where the sensor identified a thermal anomaly. Common attributes include latitude, longitude, brightness temperature, scan/track pixel size, acquisition date/time (UTC), detection confidence, fire radiative power (FRP), and day/night flag.
name: nasa-firms-active-fire-south-asia-viirs
notes:
Near-real-time active fire and thermal anomaly detections from NASA's [Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS)](https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/active_fire/) covering **South Asia**, derived from the **VIIRS** sensor family (Suomi-NPP since 2011, NOAA-20 since 2017, NOAA-21 since 2022).

Each resource is an external link directly to a NASA-hosted file. The files are continuously updated as new satellite overpasses are processed (typically within 3 hours of acquisition).

**Formats:** SHP, KML, CSV

**Time windows:** Last 24h, 48h, 7d
